title: Animation
subject: Animation & Games
summary: Develop 2D, 3D and stop-motion animation skills and build a portfolio for the creative industries.
description: You learn the craft of animation, from drawing and storytelling to industry software for 3D and visual effects.
Most of the course is project-based, so you graduate with a showreel to take to studios.
entryRequirements: A-levels, BTEC or an Access to Higher Education Diploma (Level 3), ideally in an art or design subject
GCSE English at grade 4/C or above
